Laurey 57228, Transitional Newport 128mm Cabinet Pull in Satin Nickel

The 128mm Newport Cabinet Pull in Satin Nickel is a stunning example of transitional kitchen hardware. It offers a sleek profile that isn't too modern so it will add a touch of home to your cabinets. The Large Satin Nickel Newport Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware you'll need. The Laurey 57228 Transitional Newport 128mm Cabinet Pull in Satin Nickel is suitable for use on any lightweight door or drawer.

This transitional cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Newport Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 57228 128mm Pull Newport Satin Nickel:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 5" (128mm)
  • Overall Length: 5.87"
  • Width: 0.41"
  • Projection: 1.18"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
